resources.string: Unable to play (%1$s). Check the connection and file permissions, then retry or choose another player.
Vault locked. Enter your password to unlock.
Create a vault with an independent password. Files and filenames are encrypted. Keep your password: it cannot be reset.
Use at least 12 characters and matching passwords for a new vault.
Encrypted backup exported. Keep the password separately.
Unlocked · automatically locks when leaving. Tap videos, images or text to preview; long-press a file for export and delete.
No files yet. Import a file to protect it.
Encrypted import complete. The original file is still at its source.
Encrypted file · %1$d bytes. Exporting creates a plaintext copy outside the vault. After choosing a location, unlock again to finish export.
Delete this encrypted file? This cannot be undone.
Check your password, source permissions and available storage. Leaving the app locks the vault; unlock and try again. The source file is not removed.
Run FileWeave Mac on your Mac and open Pair phone. Scan its QR code with your system camera, or paste the pairing link here. Both devices must be on the same local network.
Paste a valid FileWeave pairing link.
Confirm this is your Mac. Its certificate fingerprint is: %1$s Only approve pairing information obtained directly from your Mac.
Paired. Tap Check connection to refresh shared files.
Put files in the Mac menu’s shared folder, then refresh. Only files in that folder are exposed.
Connection failed. Check the Mac service, Wi-Fi and firewall. If the Mac certificate or pairing changed, pair again.
File sent to the Mac inbox.
Text copied to the Mac clipboard.
Encrypted backup restored. Enter the original password to unlock.
Preview unavailable. Unlock the vault again, or long-press the file to export a plaintext copy.
Export selected file to chosen location
Plaintext copy exported. This copy is not protected by the vault.
